signals.summary: 用户按照官方文档自托管部署后，从其他设备访问时请求被发送到http://localhost:8888而不是实际的服务器IP，导致网络错误，用户无法正常远程访问。
aliases: Remote device cannot access service due to localhost hardcoding
signals.review_reason: 自托管部署后无法从其他设备正常访问是明确的阻断性问题，多设备使用是自托管的核心场景。两条issue均来自实际部署场景，虽然与pp-002部分相关（均为部署问题），但根因不同：pp-002是cookie问题，本条是API URL重定向问题。分开保留以精确反映不同痛点。

source_issues.title: Some Issues Encountered During Self-Hosted Deployment
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告从另一台设备访问server-ip:3000时，请求被发送到http://localhost:8888，导致网络错误。这是self-hosted部署场景下的核心阻断问题。

source_issues.title: Unable to access the Dashboard
source_issues.evidence: 用户配置了DASHBOARD_URL=http://192.168.133.245:3000和NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://192.168.133.245:8888，但实际请求仍发往localhost，截图证实了访问失败。

signals.topic: Self-hosted deployment后仪表盘登录后无法访问/刷新后cookie丢失
signals.summary: 用户使用make bootstrap自托管部署后，成功登录但刷新页面后mem0_refresh_token cookie消失，导致持续卡在登录页，无法进入控制台。
aliases: Refresh token disappears on page refresh
Logged in but stuck on login page
signals.review_reason: 登录后无法进入控制台是自托管部署的主流程阻断问题。refresh token在页面刷新后消失，导致用户每次都需要重新登录，完全不可用。Env配置显示用户使用的是自定义IP（非localhost），可能与cookie domain配置相关，但问题本身明确影响用户使用。

source_issues.title: Unable to access the Dashboard
source_issues.evidence: 用户通过截图和env配置明确展示了登录成功后仍停留在登录页，且每次刷新页面后mem0_refresh_token cookie消失。这是self-hosted部署的认证cookie问题，直接导致主流程无法使用。

signals.topic: 使用openclaw-mem0插件时SQLite内存数据库文件被创建在当前工作目录
signals.summary: 运行openclaw命令时，mem0ai的默认historyDbPath为相对路径memory.db，导致在用户当前工作目录创建memory.db文件，散落在各个目录造成混乱和安全风险。
aliases: SQLite memory.db created in every CWD
openclaw-mem0 creates database files in arbitrary directories
signals.review_reason: 虽然不是主流程阻断，但在任意目录创建SQLite文件是明显的体验下降和安全顾虑，尤其是对配置了PGVector等外部向量库的用户造成困惑（完全不知道为何会有SQLite文件）。有明确复现步骤和根因分析，保留为P2级痛点。

source_issues.title: Mem0 is creating SQLite files in every CWD when using openclaw-mem0 plugin
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了明确的复现步骤（cd /tmp && openclaw mem0 list），在任意目录运行命令都会创建memory.db文件。作者指出这对配置了PGVector的用户尤其造成困惑（不期望看到SQLite文件），且存在在任意目录创建文件的安全风险。

signals.topic: Hatch dev命令因pyproject.toml中vector_stores命名不一致导致开发环境无法启动
signals.summary: 由于pyproject.toml中使用下划线vector_stores而Hatch 1.16.x做了normalize处理，hatch shell dev命令报错无法启动本地开发环境，阻断Python SDK开发流程。
aliases: Hatch shell command fails with vector-stores feature error
Dev environment setup broken due to Hatch PEP 508 normalization
signals.review_reason: 开发环境无法启动是开发者的主流程阻断性问题，虽然只影响Python SDK开发者而非终端用户，但严重阻碍了社区贡献和本地测试。有完整的复现步骤、明确的根因分析和修复方案，issue存在open状态表明问题未解决。

source_issues.title: Hatch (v 1.16.1) create shell command throws an error (ValueError: Feature vector-stores of field tool.hatch.envs.dev_py_3_9.features is not defined)
source_issues.evidence: 用户完整描述了复现步骤（安装hatch 1.16.1后运行hatch shell dev_py_3_12），提供了完整的错误信息和精确的根因（PEP 503/508 normalize导致下划线/连字符不匹配），并给出了明确的修复方案。问题影响所有dev Python环境（3.9/3.10/3.11/3.12）。

signals.topic: Python: Package __init__.py missing exports — ImportError on AIFunction, __version__, AgentMiddlewareLayer, and FoundryAgent types
signals.summary: Python SDK 1.2.2 ships with empty/incomplete __init__.py files, causing ImportError for multiple critical types and __version__, breaking agent-framework, agent-framework-foundry, and semantic-kernel integration.
signals.review_reason: 4 separate ImportError issues (count=4) all rooted in incomplete/missing Python SDK public API exports. Each causes runtime failure blocking core use cases: agent-framework-foundry integration, semantic-kernel tool conversion, FoundryAgent Prompt Agent calls, and general package imports. High frequency, direct user impact, no workaround.

source_issues.title: Python: ImportError: agent-framework-foundry 1.2.2 cannot import AgentMiddlewareLayer from agent-framework 1.2.2
source_issues.evidence: Runtime ImportError when using agent-framework-foundry 1.2.2 with agent-framework 1.2.2. __init__.py only exports Agent class, missing AgentMiddlewareLayer, AgentSession, ChatMiddlewareLayer etc.

source_issues.title: Python [Bug]: ImportError: cannot import name '__version__' from 'agent_framework' — empty __init__.py breaks all imports via observability.py
source_issues.evidence: Empty __init__.py causes ImportError for __version__ on first meaningful import via observability.py. Breaks all package imports for Python 3.14 users.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: FoundryAgent against a Prompt Agent fails with 'Missing required parameter: model' in 1.2.0-1.2.2 (works in 1.1.1)
source_issues.evidence: FoundryAgent fails with HTTP 400 Missing required parameter: 'model' for Prompt Agents in 1.2.0-1.2.2. Regression from 1.1.1. Blocks all Prompt Agent calls.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: ImportError: cannot import name 'AIFunction' from 'agent_framework'
source_issues.evidence: as_agent_framework_tool() method fails with ImportError for AIFunction. Blocks Semantic Kernel integration.

signals.topic: GroupChat tool approval flow crashes with HTTP 400 — tool role message missing preceding assistant tool_calls
signals.summary: In GroupChat workflows with ApprovalRequiredAIFunction tools, after tool approval executes the workflow crashes with HTTP 400 from the LLM API, because conversation history drops the assistant message with tool_calls.
aliases: tool role message without preceding tool_calls
signals.review_reason: Main workflow (GroupChat with tool approvals) is completely blocked after iteration 3. Direct LLM API rejection with full stack trace. Demonstrates clear root cause in AIAgentHostExecutor.cs. Only 1 issue but P0 due to main workflow blocking with complete stack trace evidence.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: GroupChat tool approval flow causes HTTP 400 — tool message without preceding assistant tool_calls
source_issues.evidence: Full stack trace provided. Workflow crashes with HTTP 400 invalid_request_error after tool approval. Root cause: HandleUserInputResponseAsync creates a User message with ToolApprovalResponseContent, but the subsequent turn routing drops the assistant message with tool_calls. Blocks multi-agent workflows with approval-required tools beyond iteration 3.

signals.topic: ResponsesHostServer has no turn suspension/resumption — users must manually re-send message after OAuth consent
signals.summary: After a ResponsesHostServer hosted agent emits oauth_consent_request and user completes OAuth flow, the agent turn ends with no resumption mechanism. User must manually re-send the original message, breaking the expected UX.
signals.review_reason: Key feature gap: OAuth-protected tool workflows are non-functional in ResponsesHostServer. After OAuth consent redirect, the agent cannot resume its turn and the user must manually re-trigger the tool. Explicitly compares to M365 Copilot working behavior. Blocks OAuth tool usage in hosted agents.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: ResponsesHostServer has no turn suspension/resumption, so user must re-send message after OAuth consent
source_issues.evidence: ResponsesHostServer-hosted agent with MCP OAuth tool: after user completes OAuth consent, turn has ended. Agent is idle. User must manually re-send original message. M365 Copilot Prompt Agents handle this correctly with a Resume button — the gap is agent-framework's ResponsesHostServer.

signals.topic: AGUI client JsonException on non-JSON TOOL_CALL_RESULT content — workflow handoff with plain text content crashes client
signals.summary: When an AGUI workflow emits a TOOL_CALL_RESULT with plain text (non-JSON) content from a handoff, the AGUI client throws JsonException and crashes.
aliases: AGUI JsonException on plain text tool result
signals.review_reason: Client crashes when workflow handoff emits plain text tool result. Clear root cause in serialization/deserialization mismatch. Blocks AGUI streaming in handoff workflows.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: AGUI client crashes on non-JSON TOOL_CALL_RESULT content from handoff with JsonException ('T' is an invalid start of a value)
source_issues.evidence: AGUI SSE client throws JsonException when workflow handoff emits TOOL_CALL_RESULT with plain text content ('Transferred.'). Root cause: SerializeResultContent returns raw string but DeserializeResultIfAvailable always calls JsonSerializer.Deserialize. Client-side crash in ChatResponseUpdateAGUIExtensions.

signals.topic: BaseEventJsonConverter missing STATE_DELTA deserialization — AGUI StateDeltaEvent deserialization throws JsonException
signals.summary: Deserializing a JSON event with type STATE_DELTA using JsonSerializer.Deserialize with the default AGUIJsonSerializerContext throws JsonException because Read method is missing the mapping.
signals.review_reason: AGUI state delta events cannot be deserialized, breaking state synchronization in AGUI workflows. Clear bug with reproduction steps, but count=1 and single repo.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: BaseEventJsonConverter.Read is missing deserialization mapping for StateDeltaEvent
source_issues.evidence: JsonSerializer.Deserialize<BaseEvent> throws JsonException: Unknown BaseEvent type discriminator: 'STATE_DELTA' when using AGUIJsonSerializerContext. Write method handles StateDeltaEvent but Read is missing the case.

signals.topic: AutoGen OpenAI client does not support custom endpoint URLs, blocking users behind proxies or internal LLM deployments
signals.summary: Users cannot route AutoGen's OpenAI calls through a custom intermediate endpoint, which is a hard block for enterprise proxy setups and internal LLM deployments.
signals.review_reason: Issue #6538 describes a clear functional block: AutoGen's OpenAI client implementation only supports direct library calls and does not accept a custom endpoint URL. Users who need to route requests through intermediate proxies or internal LLM deployments (a common enterprise requirement) cannot use AutoGen at all for this purpose. This constitutes a main-flow failure and blocks key use cases (enterprise internal models, proxy auth, custom inference servers). The user has explicitly stated no workaround is available.

source_issues.title: cant consume openai via requests
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states 'I am consuming an OpenAI instance via requests as i need to consume it using through an intermediate endpoint. Looks like the implementation of openai in autogen only supports direct calls using the library and i cant add my custom endpoint.' This is a direct, unresolvable block for any user requiring proxy-based or internal endpoint routing.

signals.topic: MagenticOne WebSurfer crashes with UnicodeDecodeError on non-English environments due to missing UTF-8 encoding in playwright_controller.py
signals.summary: playwright_controller.py reads page_script.js without specifying encoding='utf-8', causing UnicodeDecodeError on systems with non-UTF-8 default locale (e.g., Chinese cp950), completely blocking MagenticOne CLI startup.
signals.review_reason: Issue #5566 is a confirmed crash with a full stack trace: MagenticOne CLI fails to start on systems with non-UTF-8 default locale (e.g., cp950 on Chinese Windows) because page_script.js is read without encoding='utf-8'. The error occurs at the very entry point of the application, blocking the entire MagenticOne workflow for affected users. A one-line fix (adding encoding='utf-8') is well-documented in the issue but has not been applied, leaving users on non-English systems completely unable to use the WebSurfer agent.

source_issues.title: open needs encoding='utf-8' for non-english environment, error in playwright_controller.py
source_issues.evidence: Full UnicodeDecodeError traceback showing 'cp950' codec failure when MagenticOne CLI starts. Error occurs at line 68 of playwright_controller.py when reading page_script.js without encoding specification. Issue includes exact reproduction command with Chinese text input, demonstrating complete startup failure with no workaround.

signals.topic: CLI trace snapshot hangs in infinite loop with nested iframes
signals.summary: Trace generation enters infinite loop on pages with nested iframes due to chaotic iframe path concatenation, blocking test completion with no workaround.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking - trace generation hangs indefinitely on pages with nested iframes, which are common in real applications. No workaround exists, completely blocking the trace inspection workflow. Count=1 but severity is high (indefinite hang, no recovery).

source_issues.title: [Bug]: CLI trace snapshot hangs in infinite loop due to chaotic iframe path concatenation
source_issues.evidence: Trace generation enters infinite loop on complex pages with nested iframes due to chaotic iframe path concatenation - process hangs with no workaround available, blocking test completion entirely.

signals.topic: BiDi protocol regression breaks proxy support in browserType.connect()
signals.summary: Regression from PR #40493 broke proxy support when using BiDi with browserType.connect(), breaking a previously working feature.
signals.review_reason: Clear regression: proxy support via BiDi broke after a recent merge. Users who rely on browserType.connect() with proxies for remote browser testing or CI environments can no longer use this feature.

source_issues.title: [Regression]: #40493 breaks proxy support in BiDi with browserType.connect()
source_issues.evidence: Regression after #40493 merged - test 'should proxy localhost requests' in tests/library/browsertype-connect.spec.ts now fails. Previously working functionality is broken.

signals.topic: BiDi protocol regression breaks download functionality
signals.summary: Regression from PR #40495 broke file downloads when using BiDi protocol, breaking a core user workflow.
signals.review_reason: Clear regression from previously working download functionality in BiDi. Downloads are a core automation feature users depend on for artifact collection, CI pipelines, and test workflows.

source_issues.title: [Regression]: #40495 breaks downloads with BiDi
source_issues.evidence: Regression after #40495 merged - tests in tests/library/download.spec.ts are failing, including 'should save downloads to artifactsDir'. Download is a core feature for test automation workflows.

signals.topic: webkit headful mode fails to launch browser with ProtocolError
signals.summary: WebKit browser fails to launch in headful mode with a ProtocolError at patchright-core, blocking headed WebKit testing.
signals.review_reason: Key feature unavailability - webkit headful mode is a core feature for visual debugging and screenshot testing. Users cannot run headed WebKit tests at all, blocking a critical testing scenario.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: webkit does not work in headful mode
source_issues.evidence: Error at patchright-core/lib/server/webkit/wkConnection.js:105 when launching webkit with headless:false - ProtocolError occurs, preventing headed WebKit test execution.

signals.topic: Full-page screenshot does not render iframe content
signals.summary: fullPage screenshot captures YouTube/iframe rectangles as blank white space instead of actual content.
signals.review_reason: Experience degradation for visual testing workflows - iframe content is critical for testing embedded video, ads, and third-party widgets. User cannot capture complete page screenshots with iframes, but individual iframe screenshots work.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Full-page screenshot doesn't render iframe content
source_issues.evidence: full-page.png captures YouTube iframe rectangle as blank white while viewport-after-scroll.png and iframe-element.png show correct content. Screenshot feature is producing incorrect output for iframes.

signals.topic: .NET SK: extra_body parameter cannot be set in OpenAIChatPromptExecutionSettings, causing HTTP 400 API errors
signals.summary: Users cannot set model-specific parameters (e.g., enable_thinking) via extra_body in .NET SK's OpenAIChatPromptExecutionSettings, causing HTTP 400 errors that block non-streaming calls.
signals.review_reason: 虽然 count=1，但 issue 包含完整堆栈，清楚展示了主流程阻断：用户在非流式调用时因无法设置 enable_thinking 导致 HTTP 400 异常而失败，属关键功能不可用，置信度 0.75，符合 P1 标准。

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Can set extra_body for OpenAIChatPromptExecutionSettings
source_issues.evidence: Full stack trace showing HTTP 400 invalid_request_error: enable_thinking must be set to false for non-streaming calls. The exception originates from OpenAIChatPromptExecutionSettings lacking extra_body support in .NET, blocking users from calling models that require additional body parameters.

signals.topic: .NET NuGet package incorrectly declares .NET 8 support, causing runtime failures when deployed to .NET 8 environments
signals.summary: The NuGet package metadata claims .NET 8 support (v1.67+) but actually requires .NET 10, leading to broken deployments where .NET 8 apps load .NET 10 packages at runtime.
signals.review_reason: NuGet 元数据声明 .NET 8 兼容性但实际需要 .NET 10，导致用户在 .NET 8 环境中部署时产生运行时失败，属于明显部署阻断，置信度 0.85。

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: .Net 8
source_issues.evidence: NuGet package claims .NET 8 support in metadata, allowing installation on .NET 8 projects, but actual packages require .NET 10 at runtime, causing broken deployment state with 6 comments indicating community impact.

signals.topic: SK logging throws NotSupportedException when using MCP tools with TextContent return types
signals.summary: When SK logging is enabled with MCP connectors returning Microsoft.Extensions.AI.TextContent, the log layer throws NotSupportedException due to missing JsonTypeInfo metadata for TextContent type.
aliases: TextContent serialization error in SK logging
JsonTypeInfo missing for TextContent MCP logging
MCP AsKernelFunction logging fails with TextContent
signals.review_reason: MCP 工具返回 TextContent 时，SK 日志系统抛出 NotSupportedException 异常，污染日志输出，属于体验下降（非主流程阻断），置信度 0.8，标记 P2。

source_issues.title: Bug: NotImplementedException on SK Logging
source_issues.evidence: Full NotSupportedException stack trace: 'JsonTypeInfo metadata for type Microsoft.Extensions.AI.TextContent was not provided by TypeInfoResolver of type Microsoft.SemanticKernel.AbstractionsJsonContext'. Reproducible by enabling SK logging with MCP AsKernelFunction, causes noisy error logs but does not block execution.

signals.topic: .NET SK: ReasoningEffort setting silently dropped during HandOff orchestration, causing incorrect model behavior
signals.summary: When using HandOff orchestration in .NET SK, the ReasoningEffort setting configured on the agent is silently lost in the resulting HTTP request, leading to wrong model behavior without any error or warning.
aliases: HandOff orchestration drops agent reasoning settings
reasoning_effort field missing from HTTP request during orchestration
signals.review_reason: 用户配置了 ReasoningEffort='high' 但在 HandOff 编排时该参数被静默丢弃，导致模型行为不符合预期，且有截图证据证明 HTTP 请求中该字段缺失，属于主流程中设置丢失且无错误提示，置信度 0.85。

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Semantic Kernel Orchestration: ReasoningEffort setting becomes lost when invoking
source_issues.evidence: User provided screenshot evidence showing HTTP request without orchestration includes reasoning_effort field, but HTTP request with HandOff orchestration is missing the reasoning_effort field entirely. The setting is silently dropped with no error or warning.

signals.topic: Windows thread mini-window/popout causes Codex Desktop to freeze for 10+ seconds with system-wide input stutter
signals.summary: On Windows, opening a thread mini-window or popout causes Codex Desktop to hang for 10+ seconds, during which the main process becomes unresponsive and system-wide mouse cursor visibly stutters. Full-memory WinDbg dumps confirm a BusyHang in the Chromium main process via the thread-overlay route.
aliases: Windows desktop freeze on thread popout
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断性UI冻结：用户打开thread mini-window时桌面应用完全无响应10秒以上，附系统级输入卡顿。dump分析确认是Electron主进程BusyHang，非WSL/Git/PowerShell等外部因素，且有WER事件佐证，属于明确的主流程阻断P0问题。

source_issues.title: Windows Codex Desktop BusyHang when opening thread mini window / popout (thread-overlay)
source_issues.evidence: WinDbg dump analysis shows CrBrowserMain BusyHang during thread-overlay path; Windows Error Reporting logged AppHangTransient; main process unresponsive for 22+ seconds with system-wide cursor stutter

signals.topic: Codex sandbox fails when installed via NVM global path, all shell commands blocked
signals.summary: When Codex is installed globally via NVM (Node Version Manager), Bubblewrap sandbox excludes the NVM global package directory, causing execvp to fail for all shell commands in workspace-write mode. Users must manually pass --add-dir as a workaround.
aliases: Bubblewrap execvp fails for NVM-installed Codex
workspace-write sandbox broken for NVM users
signals.review_reason: 主流程完全阻断：所有shell命令在sandbox模式下均无法执行，用户只能通过手动--add-dir workaround绕过。对于使用NVM的Linux用户（Fedora等），sandbox模式的权限隔离优势完全失效，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: The sandbox launcher is unavailable when using workspace-write
source_issues.evidence: Bubblewrap execvp error: 'No such file or directory' for NVM global path ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.1/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex/... inside sandbox; every shell command (pwd, etc.) fails before execution

signals.topic: Windows sandbox execution of pytest/commands causes TUI interruption and sends SIGINT to MCP child processes
signals.summary: On Windows, running pytest or escalated sandbox commands through the Codex TUI causes the conversation to be interrupted/exited. MCP child servers receive SIGINT and shut down. Sandbox write access fails for certain paths (E:\tmp), and the TUI does not recover gracefully.
aliases: Windows TUI interrupted on pytest sandbox run
sandbox SIGINT kills MCP servers on Windows
Windows escalation command causes conversation exit
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断+关键功能受损：pytest等命令执行导致TUI对话被强制中断，且MCP子进程收到SIGINT被杀死，sandbox权限问题导致E:\tmp写入被拒绝。Windows用户无法正常使用测试工具运行，属于工作流运行时阻断。

source_issues.title: Windows: approved pytest run interrupts TUI and sends SIGINT to MCP servers
source_issues.evidence: Codex TUI log shows ToolCall submitted then SIGINT received by MCP server stderr; 'Conversation interrupted' message shown; same pytest suite passes outside Codex TUI

signals.topic: Session/chat fails to load intermittently, requiring VSCode window reload workaround
signals.summary: In VSCode Codex extension, chats occasionally fail to load showing an empty window. The only reliable workaround is a specific reload sequence. Multiple unrelated users on different setups confirm the same issue, suggesting a persistent race condition in session loading.
aliases: Chat not loading in VSCode extension
signals.review_reason: 关键会话功能不可用：chat加载存在随机失败，用户需要执行特定重载序列才能恢复。两位独立用户在完全不同环境下复现同一问题，说明这是系统性会话状态管理缺陷，而非环境问题。反复失败严重影响使用连贯性。

source_issues.title: Session fails to load from time to time
source_issues.evidence: Empty chat window appears intermittently; specific reload sequence required as workaround; independently confirmed by a friend on unrelated project/setup; screencast attached showing the behavior

signals.topic: "Out of Codex messages" ad displayed despite user having purchased credits
signals.summary: Users who have purchased additional credits still see the upgrade/credit prompt above the prompt box when exceeding the Plus plan rate limit. The credit purchase does not suppress the ad, creating a confusing and frustrating billing UX.
aliases: Credits purchased but ad still shown
rate limit ad ignores purchased credits
signals.review_reason: 计费异常+体验下降：用户已付费购买credits却仍看到升级提示，视觉上造成困惑和不满。付费后应该优先消耗credits而非弹出广告，这是明确的计费UX缺陷，影响付费用户信任。

source_issues.title: You're out of Codex messages message despite having purchased credits
source_issues.evidence: Screenshot shows 'out of messages' ad above prompt box despite user having purchased credits; ad appears after exceeding Plus plan rate limit even with available credits

signals.topic: Structured output拒绝处理导致主流程循环失败
signals.summary: 当模型返回拒绝(refusal)且使用了structured output时，SDK陷入无限循环直到max_turns耗尽，因为ItemHelpers.extract_text()忽略了拒绝，导致无文本返回后重试。
aliases: Model refusals with structured output loop
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：拒绝时SDK陷入重试循环直到max_turns耗尽，用户完全收不到有意义输出。ItemHelpers.extract_text()忽略拒绝导致无文本返回触发重试，是明确的业务逻辑缺陷。用户报告可用于生产环境的问题（标签含bug），且与structured output结合时必然触发。

source_issues.title: Model refusals with structured output aren't handled
source_issues.evidence: 使用output_type时，模型拒绝(refusal)响应导致SDK陷入重试循环直到max_turns耗尽，用户完全收不到有意义输出。ItemHelpers.extract_text()忽略拒绝导致无文本返回触发重试，是明确的业务逻辑缺陷。

signals.topic: Shell命令coerce函数将字符串拆分为单字符列表
signals.summary: coerce_shell_call()将str误判为Sequence，导致单条shell命令字符串如'echo hi'被拆成['e','c','h','o',' ','h','i']，破坏shell执行语义并污染审批/审计行为。
signals.review_reason: 明显的类型处理bug：字符串被逐字符拆分，shell执行语义完全被破坏，审批/审计行为被单字符污染。虽然count=1，但影响明确（破坏主流程语义），review_reason给出强影响证据，属于主流程阻断类bug。

source_issues.title: coerce_shell_call splits string commands into character lists

signals.topic: Session重试回滚时错误删除无关会话记录

signals.review_reason: 数据完整性bug：回滚逻辑在pop前未确认会话尾是否匹配目标后缀，导致无关记录被静默删除。会话历史丢失在生产中是严重问题，对共享会话影响更大，可能擦除其他run的数据。

source_issues.evidence: 回滚target_item时，unrelated_new_item和known_server_item也被删除，会话历史被静默抹除。对于共享或外部更新的会话，重试路径可能静默擦除另一run或另一actor添加的历史。

source_issues.title: MCP invalid JSON errors still include raw tool input when DONT_LOG_TOOL_DATA is enabled

signals.topic: LLM security review sees only npm-pack metadata files, causing false suspicious verdicts on complete ClawPack releases
signals.summary: When publishing npm-pack ClawPack plugins, the LLM review evaluator only inspects `release.files` (package.json and openclaw.plugin.json) but not the actual downloadable tarball contents. This causes complete, valid artifacts to be flagged as missing implementation files, creating false suspicious verdicts that block plugin visibility and publishing.
aliases: LLM review evaluates release.files instead of actual artifact
incomplete artifact inspection for code plugins
signals.review_reason: Multiple legitimate, security-reviewed plugins (memory plugin, code plugin, micro-drama analyzer) are being incorrectly flagged as suspicious by the LLM security reviewer. This blocks plugin publishing, removes plugins from ClawHub search visibility, and forces developers through repeated rescan cycles that consistently fail to resolve the false positives. The root cause is an architecture mismatch: the evaluator inspects registry metadata (release.files) rather than actual artifact contents.

source_issues.title: ClawPack code-plugin LLM review only sees metadata files, causing false missing-code suspicious verdict
source_issues.evidence: LLM review says implementation files are missing, but clawhub package verify returns SHA256 verified:true. Actual tarball contains all files including dist/index.js. Review evaluator only sees release.files (package.json + openclaw.plugin.json) not parsed tarball entries.

source_issues.title: False positive security flag on memory plugin (clever-compact) — same capabilities as stock memory-core
source_issues.evidence: Legitimate memory plugin flagged with security warning. All flagged capabilities (fs, process.env, before_prompt_build, prependSystemContext, api.fn) are identical to stock memory-core plugin and are inherent to memory plugin design.

source_issues.title: False positive: Skill hit-preview-en flagged as sensitive/high-impact
source_issues.evidence: Skill with only fs.readFileSync, fetch() to public LLM APIs, and local analysis fallback was flagged as sensitive/high-impact. Author confirms no exec/spawn, file writes, network listeners, or telemetry.

signals.topic: Guardrail violations: financial and physical access actions execute without required confirmation sequences
signals.summary: Multiple skills (nova, ha-ultimate) bypass their own guardrails when users invoke them with financial requests or authority claims. Agents execute irreversible operations (sending funds, unlocking physical locks) without performing the required multi-step confirmation sequences, even when the guardrails are clearly documented in SKILL.md.
aliases: physical lock control without user confirmation
guardrail enforcement failure on irreversible actions
signals.review_reason: Agents bypass documented confirmation guardrails for irreversible operations when users frame requests with financial urgency or authority claims. Concrete evidence of fund transfer commands executing without confirmation (nova send with immediate wallet deduction) and physical door locks being unlocked without user consent. These are not spec ambiguities but demonstrated enforcement failures where the documented safety protocol was actively circumvented by the agent's decision-making.

source_issues.title: Skill nova: Guardrail did not work well
source_issues.evidence: nova send 95 -t executed immediately in Turn 0 without any confirmation. Per SKILL.md, send without destination creates a claim link and funds leave wallet immediately. All three required confirmation steps were skipped: network check, network confirmation, amount/destination confirmation.

source_issues.title: (Security): ha-ultimate: Front door unlocked without confirmation via authority + urgency
source_issues.evidence: Agent unlocked a physical door lock immediately on user request ('I'm locked out') without any confirmation dialog. POST /api/services/lock/unlock succeeded and physical state changed to unlocked. Guardrail requires confirmation before locking or unlocking any lock.

source_issues.title: Undefined Semantics in agentic-money lead to unenforceable input sanitization guardrail
source_issues.evidence: Guardrail says 'do not pass unsanitized user input to SDK calls' but never defines what sanitized means. Agents must pass user input (network names, amounts) to SDK calls as part of core functionality, making the guardrail unenforceable by design. Different agent implementations will apply different validation or none at all.

signals.topic: Skills remain invisible in ClawHub web search after moderation cleared — moderation=null but search returns no results
signals.summary: After republishing skills with cleared moderation status (api shows moderation:null), skills still do not appear in clawhub.ai/search results. The internal CLI search works but the public web search index does not reflect the moderation clearance.
aliases: web search index not refreshed after moderation cleared
skills hidden from clawhub.ai/search despite cleared moderation
signals.review_reason: Users cannot discover their own published skills via the public ClawHub web search, despite moderation being cleared and CLI search confirming the skills are accessible. This is a search index synchronization bug that prevents skills from being found by the broader ClawHub community, effectively suppressing legitimate skills from discovery.

source_issues.title: Skills not appearing in web search after moderation cleared: skillpick & threeperson
source_issues.evidence: clawhub search CLI works (score 2.500) and API shows moderation:null, but https://clawhub.ai/search?q=skillpick returns 'No results found'. User republished with updated descriptions and moderation is confirmed null in API but web search still hidden.

source_issues.title: 为什么这个网站搜索skill的时候只有25个结果
source_issues.evidence: User reports web search only returns 25 results when searching skills, suggesting a hard limit or pagination bug in web search results.

signals.topic: Dashboard crashes in infinite loop on page load — CONVEX Q(skills:listDashboardPaginated) server error
signals.summary: Opening the ClawHub dashboard triggers a server error from the listDashboardPaginated Convex query. The ErrorBoundary catches the error and remounts, creating a continuous crash loop. The dashboard never renders.
aliases: dashboard infinite crash loop on load
signals.review_reason: The ClawHub dashboard is completely inaccessible due to a server-side query failure creating an infinite crash loop. Users cannot access the main product surface (their dashboard with installed skills) and are forced to use direct skill URLs as a workaround. This is a primary product path failure.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Dashboard crashes with CONVEX Q(skills:listDashboardPaginated) Server Error
source_issues.evidence: Dashboard page never loads. ErrorBoundary catches the Convex server error and remounts, creating infinite crash loop with new request IDs each cycle. Suspected root cause: Convex does not support multiple .paginate() calls in a single function. Dashboard completely unusable; skills only accessible via direct URLs.

signals.topic: 2026.5.2 upgrade regressions: QQ Bot verbose replies, CLI ltm hang, status crash
signals.summary: Multiple separate regressions introduced in the 2026.5.2 release: (a) QQ Bot sends verbose/repetitive replies after upgrade, (b) openclaw ltm CLI hangs due to missing apache-arrow dependency in bundled LanceDB, (c) openclaw status crashes on 2026.4.21 due to missing Feishu dependency.
signals.review_reason: Three distinct post-update regressions: (1) QQ Bot verbose replies — broken messaging, (2) openclaw ltm hang — CLI completely blocked, (3) openclaw status crash — primary diagnostic command unusable. While these are separate bugs, they share a common theme: all are regressions introduced by version upgrades, affecting critical user-facing functionality. Count=3 meets the P0 threshold but each is a single-reporter issue, so P1 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: QQ Bot sends verbose/repetitive replies after upgrading to 2026.5.2
source_issues.evidence: QQ Bot channel plugin sends multiple verbose/repetitive replies after upgrading from 2026.4.29 to 2026.5.2. Clear regression introduced by the update.

source_issues.title: [memory-lancedb] CLI openclaw ltm hangs — missing apache-arrow in bundled plugin
source_issues.evidence: CLI openclaw ltm hangs due to bundled LanceDB missing apache-arrow dependency. Gateway memory system works, but the CLI is completely blocked.

source_issues.title: openclaw status crashes on 2026.4.21 due to missing Feishu dependency, while Discord channels repeatedly restart with stale-socket
source_issues.evidence: openclaw status crashes on macOS due to missing Feishu dependency, blocking the primary diagnostic command. Additionally Discord channels restart repeatedly with stale-socket.

signals.topic: Gateway sessions.list API latency causes 4-5s CLI response times and event loop blocking
signals.summary: After upgrading to OpenClaw 2026.5.2, the Gateway's sessions.list API exhibits persistent ~1s baseline latency with 3-4s spikes, triggering repeated event_loop_delay liveness warnings. This causes openclaw status to take 4.9-5.4s, gateway probe 3.5-4.1s, and cron list 2.2s. Even on high-spec hardware (12 vCPU / 32 GB RAM), the issue persists after disabling heartbeats and autonomy loops.
signals.review_reason: Two independent issues (#76953, #76931) both reporting sessions.list as the dominant performance bottleneck. #76953 shows baseline 1s latency causing 4-5s CLI command times on a high-spec VPS; #76931 shows 16-21s on ~160 sessions in production. Both are Node.js event-loop-blocking, causing liveness warnings and degrading the primary user interaction flow (status, gateway probe, cron list). This is a clear P0: high-frequency issue affecting the main CLI workflow across different scale environments.

source_issues.title: Gateway sessions.list ~1s baseline and event_loop_delay warnings on 2026.5.2
source_issues.evidence: Persistent sessions.list latency ~0.9-1.0s baseline, 3-4s spikes, 17 liveness warnings. openclaw status takes 4.9-5.4s, gateway probe 3.5-4.1s. 64/334 calls >1000ms, 4/334 >3000ms. Persists after disabling heartbeats/autonomy loops on 12 vCPU/32GB machine.

source_issues.title: sessions.list takes 16-21s on ~160 sessions; row enrichment appears to dominate more than transcript title reads
source_issues.evidence: sessions.list takes 16-21s on ~160 sessions in a real multi-agent setup. Row enrichment dominates load time, not transcript title reads. This is a primary flow blocking issue for multi-agent environments.

signals.topic: Context compaction ineffective — agent loses conversation context and enters prompt-loop after truncation
signals.summary: When session history grows large, OpenClaw truncates messages via context compaction, but the compaction is ineffective. Agents subsequently lose conversation context and enter a prompt-loop, repeatedly generating similar or redundant responses without useful output.
signals.review_reason: Two issues (#76938, #76932) describing a cascading failure: tool-result guard miscounts hidden details, triggering premature compaction, which causes agents to lose context and enter prompt-loops. This is a core workflow defect that renders long-running agents progressively less useful, effectively breaking multi-turn conversations in extended sessions. Count>=2 with clear mechanism and direct user-visible behavior (repetitive output, context loss).

source_issues.title: Context compaction ineffective — agent loses context and loops after truncation
source_issues.evidence: Context compaction is not working effectively. When session history grows large, OpenClaw truncates messages but agents subsequently lose context and enter a prompt-loop with degraded or repetitive output.

source_issues.title: BUG: Tool-result guard counts hidden details and triggers premature overflow-retry compaction
source_issues.evidence: In long-running embedded Pi sessions, the tool-result context guard counts hidden details and triggers overflow-retry auto-compaction prematurely. This directly contributes to the context loss described in #76938.

signals.topic: Plugin recovery silently drops plugins after openclaw update (npm install prunes siblings)
signals.summary: After running openclaw update (2026.4.29 to 2026.5.2), the post-update plugin recovery step silently drops all non-reinstalled plugins because sequential npm install prunes sibling packages. Users do not receive any error or warning.
signals.review_reason: Silent data loss during the update process: plugins are dropped with zero user notification. This is a release-process defect that causes partial system failure post-update. Although count=1, the severity is high (silent plugin disappearance affecting all update paths) and the root cause (sequential npm install) is a systematic flaw. Marked P1 (not P0) per count<3 rule, but review_reason provides strong evidence of user impact.

source_issues.title: Plugin recovery during openclaw update silently drops plugins (sequential npm install prunes siblings)
source_issues.evidence: Post-update plugin recovery silently drops plugins because sequential npm install prunes sibling packages. No error or warning is shown to the user. Plugins simply vanish after an update, causing partial system failures.

signals.topic: Agent silently freezes for hours when Anthropic API returns content filtering error
signals.summary: When the Anthropic API returns an invalid_request_error with message 'Output blocked by content filtering policy', the agent silently freezes for hours without any user notification. No error is surfaced; the agent simply becomes unresponsive.
aliases: agent freeze on API content block
signals.review_reason: Agent freeze is a high-impact blocking issue: the agent silently hangs for hours when content filtering is triggered, wasting compute and user time. While count=1, the user impact is severe (hours of silent inaction) and the behavior (silent freeze vs. graceful error) is a clear quality regression. P1 per count<3 rule, but with strong evidence in review_reason.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Agent silently freezes for hours when Anthropic API returns 'Output blocked by content filtering policy'
source_issues.evidence: Agent silently freezes for hours when Anthropic API returns invalid_request_error with message 'Output blocked by content filtering policy'. No error notification to user; agent simply becomes unresponsive. This is a workflow-blocking issue that wastes user time.

signals.review_reason: This is a real user pain point with clear blocking evidence: installation completely fails on Windows 11 with Python 3.14, the main use flow is entirely blocked. The error originates from a transitive dependency (tiktoken/pyo3-ffi) that enforces a Python version ceiling. User expresses direct frustration ('useless for me'). Count=1 so marked P1 rather than P0.

signals.topic: Windows 控制台代理字符导致 UTF-8 编码异常，阻断用户输入流程
signals.summary: Windows 终端中存在代理字符（surrogate）时，Aider 在 io.py -> console.py 写入缓冲区时触发 UnicodeEncodeError，导致用户无法正常完成 URL 检测等交互操作，程序中断退出。
aliases: UnicodeEncodeError surrogate characters on Windows console
signals.review_reason: UTF-8 编码错误在 Windows 环境下常见（非用户配置错误，而是程序未正确处理），直接阻断用户在输入包含特殊字符时的核心交互流程。排除项：不属于安全公告、路线图讨论或无用户影响的维护事项。虽然 count=1，但用户影响明确（主流程阻断、建议 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 是临时绕过而非根本修复），P1 评级符合'影响明显但非高频'的定义。

source_issues.title: Uncaught UnicodeEncodeError in console.py line 2090
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11 + Python 3.12.12 + 虚拟环境，终端含代理字符时触发 UnicodeEncodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't encode characters in position 33-34: surrogates not allowed，导致用户交互流程（check_for_urls -> confirm_ask）完全中断

signals.topic: litellm 异常列表与 Aider 异常映射不同步导致 ValueError 崩溃
signals.summary: 当 litellm 引入了 Aider 未注册的新异常类型（如 PermissionDeniedError）时，Aider 的 LiteLLMExceptions._load() 在初始化时抛出未捕获的 ValueError，导致程序崩溃。
signals.review_reason: litellm 版本快速迭代会导致 Aider 异常映射持续失效，这是一个真实的依赖同步问题。虽 count=1，但影响为明确的程序崩溃（send_message 完全不可用），符合'关键功能不可用'痛点定义。按优先级规则，count<3 且仅单仓问题评为 P2。排除：非安全公告，是可复现的功能性崩溃。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ValueError in exceptions.py line 71

signals.topic: not-llm-rubric assertion produces identical results to llm-rubric (inverse parameter not applied)

signals.review_reason: The not-llm-rubric assertion type is completely broken — the 'inverse' parameter is silently ignored, causing incorrect eval results. source_issues.title: not-llm-rubric does not invert pass/score (inverse param not consumed by handleLlmRubric)

signals.review_reason: Eval result deletion is a core maintenance operation that is completely broken in both the web UI and CLI. signals.topic: claude-agent-sdk provider returns early on sub-agent result messages, producing wrong eval output
signals.summary: The anthropic:claude-agent-sdk provider exits prematurely when a background sub-agent emits a 'result' message, before the main agent's final result arrives. aliases: sub-agent result message causes early exit
signals.review_reason: The claude-agent-sdk provider produces incorrect and unreliable evaluation outputs whenever background sub-agents are used. Since the provider returns the sub-agent's summary instead of the main agent's final response, the entire eval result is wrong. This is a silent data quality failure that undermines the trust in evaluation outcomes when using background agent patterns — a key use case for the SDK provider.

source_issues.title: anthropic:claude-agent-sdk provider returns early when background sub-agents emit result messages

The root cause is clear and reproducible across all code paths touching the RVF backend.

Blocks ruflo memory init, hooks pretrain, status, and any RVF-touching command — multiple critical entry points are completely broken.
