signals.topic: Background daemon silently dies on Windows with Node 25 — process.execPath space-quoting causes path truncation
signals.summary: daemon start (background mode) on Windows + Node 25.9.0 spawns a child process that exits within milliseconds. The child never writes daemon.log and leaves a stale daemon.pid. Root cause: process.execPath contains a space (C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe) and startBackgroundDaemon() does not quote it, causing cmd.exe to parse it as a truncated path.
signals.review_reason: The background daemon feature is completely non-functional on Windows — a common developer environment. The daemon silently fails with no actionable error, leaving a stale PID file. This is a significant quality regression for the Windows user base, as background daemon operation is a core workflow feature.

source_issues.title: daemon start (background) silently dies on Windows + Node 25 — process.execPath space-quoting under shell:true
source_issues.evidence: User reports: 'daemon start (background mode) spawns a child that exits within milliseconds, never writes daemon.log, and leaves a stale daemon.pid. The actual failure is in startBackgroundDaemon() — the spawned node.exe is being parsed by cmd.exe as a truncated path because process.execPath contains a space (C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe).' Affects the entire background daemon feature for Windows users.

signals.topic: Repacked agentdb package is missing dist/utils/vector-math.js causing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in hierarchical memory
signals.summary: The agentdb package repackaged inside @claude-flow/cli ships with a malformed dist/ layout. dist/controllers/HierarchicalMemory.js imports ../utils/vector-math.js but that file does not exist at dist/utils/ — only at dist/src/utils/. This is a recurring packaging bug (similar to now-closed #1343 and #1471) that breaks hierarchical memory consolidation silently.
signals.review_reason: The hierarchical memory consolidation feature silently fails due to a missing file in the repackaged agentdb. This is the third recurrence of the same packaging bug class (after #1343 and #1471), indicating a systemic issue with the claude-flow repack build process. Users lose memory consolidation functionality with no clear error message.

source_issues.title: claude-flow's repacked agentdb is missing dist/utils/vector-math.js — HierarchicalMemory.js silently ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
source_issues.evidence: User provides concrete reproduction steps showing dist/utils/ is empty/missing while dist/src/utils/vector-math.js exists. The failure is silent in the daemon path and surfaces as hierarchical memory operations becoming no-ops. This is the third occurrence of the same bug class (#1343, #1471, now #1721), indicating a systemic repackaging problem.

signals.topic: Headless Chrome silently blocks geolocation API — session-setup does not pre-grant permissions, causing getCurrentPosition to fail or return PERMISSION_DENIED
signals.summary: In headless mode, Chrome suppresses geolocation prompts but the tool never pre-grants permissions, making navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition() unusable for any page without a manual workaround.
aliases: geolocation permission not granted in headless
signals.review_reason: count=2, headless geolocation API is fundamentally non-functional — this is a core API capability blocked in headless mode, which is the primary use case for this tool.

source_issues.title: session-setup doesn't pre-grant geolocation; permission prompts skipped or silently fail
source_issues.evidence: navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition() either fires PERMISSION_DENIED callback or fires no callback at all. No CDP pre-grant is called during session-setup. Workaround requires knowing coordinates ahead of time via 'set geo', which is not viable for production automation.

signals.topic: --auto-connect fails on Chrome M136+ default profile due to absent DevToolsActivePort file — silent timeout instead of clear error
signals.summary: Chrome M136+ security tightening prevents DevToolsActivePort file creation on default/user profiles. --auto-connect silently times out or no-ops, making seamless attach to existing Chrome impossible.
signals.review_reason: count=2, auto-connect is a primary UX feature for seamless Chrome session reuse; its failure on Chrome M136+ (current stable) with silent timeout is a workflow blocker with no in-tool workaround.

source_issues.title: --auto-connect fails on Chrome M136+ default profile (DevToolsActivePort not created)
source_issues.evidence: Chrome M136+ security change: DevToolsActivePort file is not created for default/user profiles. auto-connect reads this file to discover the debug port; without it the handshake never reaches CDP. Reproduced on macOS with signed-in Chrome. Workaround requires launching a separate Chrome instance with explicit --remote-debugging-port on a fresh user-data-dir.

signals.topic: browser type command uses execCommand('insertText') which does not update DraftJS/React state — automation silently fails on Twitter/X, Notion, and other rich-text editors
signals.summary: The 'type' command visually inserts text into DraftJS editors but does not trigger React state, causing form submissions to send empty content. This is a silent failure that makes task automation unreliable.
aliases: DraftJS state not updated by type command
signals.review_reason: Single issue but explicitly describes silent failure of core 'type' command on widely-used frameworks (DraftJS powers Twitter/X, Notion, etc.). Agents following documented workflows would get false success signals, making outputs unreliable.

source_issues.title: Feature Request: Support CDP Input.insertText for DraftJS-compatible text input
source_issues.evidence: document.execCommand('insertText') updates the DOM but DraftJS editors (Twitter/X, Notion, and many other web apps) deliberately ignore execCommand events. CDP Input.insertText correctly triggers React synthetic events. The type command fails silently — text appears visually but submit produces empty content.

signals.topic: open command hangs at 0-byte stdout for 16+ minutes on Windows 11 before failing — pre-handshake IPC initialization failure blocks entire workflow
signals.summary: On Windows 11, the first 'open' call against a fresh session hangs indefinitely with no stdout/stderr. The hang occurs at handshake/IPC initialization before any command completes. Workaround is migrating to Playwright MCP.
aliases: IPC initialization failure on Windows fresh session
signals.review_reason: The open command hangs for 16+ minutes on Windows 11 before silently failing with no error output. This completely blocks the primary workflow on a major platform. Despite count=1, the severity and complete workflow blockage on Windows warrants P0 with explicit strong evidence.

source_issues.title: open hangs pre-handshake on Windows 11 (0-byte stdout, 16+ min) — distinct from #1138
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced twice on Windows 11 (10.0.26200) with agent-browser 0.26.0 via npm. 0-byte stdout for 16+ minutes. No error in stderr or daemon log. No cleanup-timeouts.log created (close step never reached). Daemon never produces first response — hang at handshake before any successful command. User migrated to Playwright MCP as workaround.

signals.topic: Official docs show @e16 selector format for click but CLI rejects it as 'Missing arguments' — CLI argument parsing mismatch prevents documented workflow execution
signals.summary: User following the official quick-start documentation runs 'agent-browser click @e16' but receives 'Missing arguments for: click'. The @ref syntax shown in snapshot output is not accepted as a valid selector argument, breaking the documented workflow.
signals.review_reason: User directly follows official quick-start documentation and the documented workflow fails. This is a critical UX failure — new users hit an error on their first real automation step. Evidence is concrete and reproducible.

source_issues.title: Missing arguments for: click
source_issues.evidence: User follows official quick-start docs exactly: runs 'agent-browser snapshot -i' to get refs (shows 'button Toggle theme [ref=e16]'), then runs 'agent-browser click @e16' and gets 'Missing arguments for: click'. CLI usage shows 'agent-browser click <selector> [--new-tab]'. The @ prefix shown in snapshot output is not accepted.

signals.topic: Zod v4.4.x incompatibility breaks Bedrock tool calls and MCP tool results
signals.summary: Zod v4.4.x changed `z.unknown()` semantics so it now requires keys to be present in objects, breaking Bedrock streaming tool parsing (no `input` field on `contentBlockStart`) and MCP tool result parsing (resource_link union arm missing). All tool calls fail at runtime with AI_TypeValidationError.
signals.review_reason: All tool calls through @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock (one of the flagship providers) fail at runtime under Zod v4.4.x — a version that is within the package's own peer dependency range. This is a hard blocker: every tool-using Bedrock user who does a routine dependency update will have their agentic loops crash. Three independent reports confirm it affects both the Bedrock streaming parser and the MCP package's tool result schema. The failure is silent in the sense that requests succeed on the wire but the SDK throws during parsing, and no graceful fallback exists.

source_issues.title: `BedrockToolUseSchema` rejects valid `contentBlockStart` events under Zod ≥ 4.4.0
source_issues.evidence: Every tool call through @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock fails with AI_TypeValidationError under zod@>=4.4.0. Bedrock's Converse Stream API never sends `input` on `contentBlockStart`; only arrives later via contentBlockDelta. Schema declares `input: z.unknown()` which Zod v4 now requires. Workaround is pin zod to ^4.3.x or patch-package.

source_issues.title: @ai-sdk/mcp: CallToolResultSchema rejects resource_link content parts with zod ≥ 4.4.x
source_issues.evidence: MCP spec defines resource_link as a fourth content part variant. CallToolResultSchema only allows TextContentSchema | ImageContentSchema | EmbeddedResourceSchema. Under zod ~4.3.6 missing union arms were tolerated; under zod >= 4.4.1 the provider hard-rejects it and throws 'Failed to parse server response' from callTool(). Peer-dep range permits 4.4.x so surfaces on routine pnpm update.

source_issues.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): BedrockToolUseSchema input field breaks with zod@4.4.x
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed: `input: z.unknown()` rejects missing key under zod@4.4.1 with error 'expected nonoptional, received undefined'. Works under zod@4.3.6. PR fix: change to `input: z.unknown().optional()`. Affects 4.0.98 and 5.0.0-beta.46.

signals.topic: Vertex thoughtSignature dropped on no-args tool calls — breaking multi-turn agentic conversations
signals.summary: The Google/Vertex streaming parser drops entire tool-call chunks when the model invokes a tool with no required arguments. Because Vertex attaches the required thoughtSignature to the first function call, dropping the no-args call means zero signatures reach the response. The next agent step then gets a 400 from Vertex (missing thought_signature). Same bug exists in both @ai-sdk/google-vertex (direct) and AI Gateway (gateway path).
aliases: Vertex tool call dropped streaming parser
signals.review_reason: This is a primary-flow blocker: agentic multi-turn conversations with Gemini 3 thinking models fail ~50% of the time because the SDK silently drops tool calls that have no arguments. The user must either restructure every tool to have a required argument or accept that half their conversations break. The bug affects both the direct Vertex path and the AI Gateway path, meaning users of both deployment patterns are impacted. Wire-level evidence and comparison tables are provided. This is not an edge case — it is triggered by a common pattern (tools with no required fields).

source_issues.title: `@ai-sdk/google` streaming parser drops no-args function calls, losing `thoughtSignature`
source_issues.evidence: When streamFunctionCallArguments:true and model picks a no-args tool, the streaming parser's three-classifier logic (isStreamingChunk / isTerminalChunk / isCompleteCall) has no branch for {name, no args, no willContinue, no partialArgs}. The chunk falls through and is never emitted. Vertex emits the thoughtSignature on the first call; if that call is dropped, the response has zero signatures and the next agent step 400s. User sees ~50% of multi-turn chat continuations fail. Reproduction provided with wire-level evidence. Workaround: add a required argument to every tool.

source_issues.title: AI Gateway: `providerMetadata.vertex.thoughtSignature` dropped on `tool-call` events when routing to Vertex Gemini
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause manifested via the gateway path. When routing through gateway('google/gemini-3-flash-preview') with only:['vertex'], the thoughtSignature is absent from all tool-call events. callProviderMetadata is never set on saved tool parts. Direct createVertex works fine. The next agent step POSTs with no signature and Vertex returns 400. User compares DB rows: direct=6/6 calls with signature, gateway=0/4 calls with signature.

signals.topic: Vertex serviceTier 'priority' rejected; labels silently dropped through AI Gateway BYOK
signals.summary: Two distinct but related bugs: (1) Direct @ai-sdk/google-vertex rejects serviceTier:'priority' because the SDK sends lowercase 'priority' instead of mapping to the Vertex API enum value 'PRIORITY'. (2) AI Gateway BYOK path silently drops both serviceTier and labels from the Vertex request — priority quota is not used and GCP billing labels are blank.
aliases: Vertex labels not forwarded gateway BYOK
signals.review_reason: The first bug is a clear API contract mismatch (lowercase vs uppercase enum) that makes a paid premium feature inaccessible. The second bug is a silent failure: requests succeed, users see no error, but they are billed as Standard traffic and their cost attribution labels are blank. Users who configured BYOK with Priority expectations will discover the problem through billing analysis, not error messages. Combined impact: paid feature unusable + billing opacity. Single report but with strong reproduction evidence including exact API error messages.

source_issues.title: Vertex priority service tier + labels not propagated (direct provider rejects 'priority', Gateway BYOK drops both)
source_issues.evidence: User has a GCP org with Priority Pay-as-you-go access. Bug 1: direct path returns 'Invalid value at service_tier...priority' because SDK sends lowercase string instead of Vertex API enum. Bug 2: through Gateway BYOK, request succeeds but GCP shows no Priority billing — the gateway does not forward vertex.providerOptions.serviceTier or labels to the underlying Vertex call. User loses priority quota access and cannot do cost attribution via GCP labels.

signals.topic: Bedrock prompt caching silently fails when cachePoint attached to content parts
signals.summary: When using @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock with prompt caching, attaching a cachePoint to an individual message content part (rather than the whole message) results in zero cache activity — cache_write=0 and cache_read=0. Requests succeed but the caching optimization is entirely bypassed, causing repeated token costs on every request for content that should be cached.
aliases: Bedrock cachePoint content part not working
prompt caching content level fails bedrock
signals.review_reason: This causes a direct monetary cost: users who expect per-content-part caching (a documented Bedrock feature) silently pay full token prices on every repeated request. The failure is invisible — no error, no warning — so users may not notice until they review billing. It blocks a core Bedrock cost optimization feature.

source_issues.title: Bug: Bedrock drops cache points on message content parts
source_issues.evidence: User attaches cachePoint:{type:'default'} to a text content part inside a message. Bedrock Converse API supports this per the official docs (cachePoint inside messages[].content[]). The request succeeds but usage reports cacheWriteTokens:0 and cacheReadTokens:0. The cache point is not being forwarded to Bedrock's request body. The workaround is to attach cachePoint at the message level, but per-content-part caching is a legitimate and documented use case.

signals.topic: embed() crashes with TypeError when EmbeddingModelV2 providers omit warnings field
signals.summary: embed() and embedMany() crash at runtime when used with any provider implementing EmbeddingModelV2 (e.g. older @ai-sdk/google-vertex@3.0.x), because the v2 doEmbed return type does not include a warnings field, but the SDK assumes it is always defined and reads warnings.length or spreads it without null-checking.
aliases: EmbeddingModelV2 warnings field missing runtime crash
signals.review_reason: Core API (embed/embedMany) crashes on every call for any consumer using a v2 embedding provider with current ai SDK — a supported combination per the adapter chain. The crash is in a code path the SDK declares as public API surface. No graceful degradation; every embed call throws TypeError.

source_issues.title: embed() and embedMany() crash with EmbeddingModelV2 providers that omit `warnings`
source_issues.evidence: SDK declares EmbeddingModelV2 as part of the public surface and has a v2→v3→v4 adapter chain. However, embed.ts line 196, embed-many.ts lines 218 and 320 propagate modelResponse.warnings without null-checking. logWarnings crashes on warnings.length; embed-many.ts:330 crashes on warnings.push(...result.warnings). Any consumer pinning a v2-era provider alongside a current ai SDK will hit TypeError on every embed call. Reproduction provided with MockEmbeddingModelV2.

signals.topic: NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS env var disables internal header filtering in production
signals.summary: Setting NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS skips all filterInternalHeaders() calls, allowing external clients to forge internal headers (x-middleware-rewrite, x-middleware-redirect, x-matched-path, x-middleware-set-cookie). If accidentally set in production via CI/CD misconfiguration, enables SSRF and arbitrary redirects.
aliases: internal header filtering disabled by env var
signals.review_reason: 安全缺陷(count=3)且有明确利用路径：CI/CD误配置即可在生产环境绕过内部头过滤，导致SSRF和任意重定向风险。用户影响明确（生产安全边界被突破），非泛化安全公告。

source_issues.title: [Bug] NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS env var disables all internal header filtering
source_issues.evidence: When NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS is set, filterInternalHeaders() is entirely skipped in router-server.ts:230-232. External client can forge x-middleware-rewrite to bypass middleware, x-matched-path to control rendered page, x-middleware-redirect for arbitrary redirect, x-middleware-set-cookie for arbitrary cookies. No warning emitted in production.

source_issues.title: [Bug] NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS env var disables all internal header filtering
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause as #93440. Reproduction shows header filtered without env var (safe), not filtered with env var (vulnerable). Risk table documents all affected headers and their exploit impact.

source_issues.title: [Bug] NEXT_PRIVATE_TEST_HEADERS env var disables all internal header filtering
source_issues.evidence: Third duplicate. Risk documented: if env var leaks into production via CI/CD, attacker can forge internal headers to bypass security controls.

signals.topic: useSearchParams with Suspense breaks page rendering in production (Next.js 16.2.4)
signals.summary: Client components using useSearchParams wrapped in Suspense boundary throw errors or render incorrectly in production builds (next build && npm start) but work correctly in development. Specific to Next.js 16.2.4.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用(count=2)：useSearchParams是App Router高频使用API，在Suspense下生产构建直接报错，阻断用户生产部署流程。非边缘场景，App Router生产部署失败为主流用例。

source_issues.title: Next.js 16.2.4 - useSearchParams breaks accessibility (a11y) in production
source_issues.evidence: Component using useSearchParams wrapped in Suspense boundary renders incorrectly or throws error in production (next build && npm start). Development mode works correctly. Repro repo provided with next@16.2.4, react@19.2.4.

source_issues.title: Next.js 16.2.4 - useSearchParams breaks accessibility (a11y) in production
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of #93426. Same reproduction steps and version environment. Issue marked with 'invalid link' label.

signals.topic: PPR resume mismatch when htmlLimitedBots is set despite disabling streaming metadata
signals.summary: With cacheComponents and htmlLimitedBots: /.*/, server logs React resume mismatch errors: 'Expected the resume to render div but instead rendered __next_metadata_boundary__'. Affects RSC prefetch requests and browser-like user-agents, despite htmlLimitedBots supposedly fully disabling streaming metadata.
aliases: PPR metadata boundary resume error htmlLimitedBots
signals.review_reason: PPR流式渲染场景下的React hydration降级(count=2)：错误配置下PPR退化为全客户端渲染，SEO关键路由的metadata无法正确服务端渲染，影响Googlebot索引和真实用户体验。有明确报错digest和服务器日志证据。

source_issues.title: PPR metadata resume mismatch despite htmlLimitedBots fully disabling streaming metadata
source_issues.evidence: Error: Expected the resume to render <div> in this slot but instead it rendered <__next_metadata_boundary__>. The tree doesn't match so React will fallback to client rendering. With cacheComponents: true and htmlLimitedBots: /.*/, browser UA returns streaming metadata wrapper despite htmlLimitedBots. React resume mismatch digest logged on server.

source_issues.title: PPR resume mismatch on RSC prefetch with htmlLimitedBots renders __next_metadata_boundary__
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate of #93401. Server logs React resume mismatch on RSC prefetch path. Workaround guard script provided. Same cacheComponents + htmlLimitedBots configuration.

signals.topic: Turbopack dev mode: React hydration fails with middleware rewrites in Next.js 16.2.4
signals.summary: Turbopack dev mode regression: pages using middleware rewrites fail to hydrate — buttons non-interactive, client components stuck in loading state, with no errors after cache clear. Only affects next dev with Turbopack; production build works correctly.
aliases: React hydration fails in Turbopack dev
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程阻断：React hydration完全失败导致页面无交互能力，核心功能不可用。明确regression而非新功能问题，影响所有使用Turbopack+中间件重写的App Router项目。虽count=1但影响严重且有明确可复现步骤。

source_issues.title: Turbopack dev mode: pages fail to hydrate in 16.2.4 (works in 16.1.3 and production build)
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'payload') in core.js:297. After clearing .next cache, server-renders correctly but React never hydrates — buttons not clickable, client components stuck in loading state, no interactivity. next build && next start works perfectly — regression is Turbopack dev mode only.

signals.topic: Navigating back from 404 page destroys React interactivity in dev mode (Next.js 16.2.4)
signals.summary: After pressing browser back button from a 404 page in next dev mode, the previous page loses all React interactivity: state resets, buttons non-functional, counter stops working. F5 refresh restores functionality. Production (next start) unaffected. Regression from Next.js 15.
aliases: 404 back button React state loss dev
back navigation from 404 breaks client interactivity
browser back from 404 page state reset
signals.review_reason: 开发体验严重退化：next dev是核心开发流程，404返回后React状态完全丢失（主流程阻断），且无控制台错误让用户难以定位。明确是v16对v15的regression，影响所有使用App Router的开发者。

source_issues.title: Next.js 16.2.4 - Bug When Navigating Back from 404 in Development
source_issues.evidence: Back button from 404 page causes React state loss and total loss of client interactivity in dev mode. Buttons non-responsive, counter stops working. F5 refresh required to restore. Production (next start) works fine. Regression from v15 confirmed by reporter. No errors in console. Tested on Chrome and Firefox. Minimal repro project provided.

signals.topic: SDK 最新版本未发布至 npm，导致用户无法安装最新版本
signals.summary: Vercel SDK 最新版本 1.19.41 未成功发布至 npm registry，用户通过 npm install 无法获取最新版本，阻塞所有依赖该 SDK 的安装/升级流程。
signals.review_reason: npm 包发布失败是直接阻断性发布流程问题——所有依赖该 SDK 的用户都无法通过 npm 安装最新版本 1.19.41，导致依赖升级流程中断。虽然 count=1（单仓），但影响范围覆盖所有通过 npm 安装该 SDK 的用户，属于明确的用户可感知阻断场景，符合 P1 级别。

source_issues.title: Latest npm sdk version not published
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确指出版本 1.19.41 在 GitHub Actions 发布流程完成后未出现在 npm 上，并附上了 CI 运行记录链接。

signals.topic: turbo prune --docker generates invalid Bun lockfile causing Docker build to fail
signals.summary: turbo prune --docker 生成的剪枝 Bun lockfile 无效，导致 bun install --frozen-lockfile 在 Docker 构建阶段失败并报错 'lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen'。阻断 Docker 构建主流程。
aliases: turbo prune bun docker lockfile invalid
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：Docker 构建失败是 monorepo 生产部署的关键环节。Bun prune 生成的 lockfile 与 bun install --frozen-lockfile 校验不匹配，直接导致 CI/CD pipeline 失败，有完整复现仓库和 Dockerfile 证据。

source_issues.title: `turbo prune --docker` generates invalid Bun lockfile; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` fails in pruned Docker stage
source_issues.evidence: Docker build fails at 'bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts' with error 'lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen'. Root lockfile is valid; only the pruned out/json/bun.lock is invalid.

signals.topic: Turbo silently scans entire home directory and hangs indefinitely when project has no .git (ZIP download scenario)
signals.summary: 当项目目录没有 .git 文件夹（如从 GitHub 下载 ZIP）时，turbo 向上遍历文件系统找到父目录的 .git（可能位于 home 目录），然后扫描 home 下所有文件（数十万文件），导致命令无限挂起且无任何输出。
aliases: turbo hang without git no output
turbo no git zip download hang
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：新用户首次使用 turbo 时极易触发（下载 ZIP 模板是标准操作）。无错误提示、无进度输出、完全挂起，用户无法判断是否在运行，严重损害首次体验，是典型的静默失败。

source_issues.title: Turbo silently scans entire home directory and hangs when project has no .git (ZIP download)
source_issues.evidence: turbo 无错误无警告地挂起，扫描整个 home 目录（数十万文件），DEBUG 日志确认从 /Users/xxx 开始遍历，用户只能强制终止进程。常见场景：ZIP 下载项目、无 .git 克隆、IDE 模板。

signals.topic: Turbo cannot parse pnpm 11 lockfiles with new flat-string patchedDependencies format
signals.summary: pnpm 11 将 patchedDependencies 格式从 {path, hash} 结构改为纯哈希字符串，turbo 的 PatchFile 解析器无法处理，导致每次运行都发出警告并回退到基于文件内容哈希的降级缓存失效策略，CI 环境中持续出现噪音。
signals.review_reason: 影响范围广：所有使用 pnpm 11 且有 patched 依赖的用户每次运行都会收到警告，CI 日志持续污染。更关键的是 turbo 失去了 lockfile 感知的缓存失效能力，回退到文件内容哈希，性能下降。

source_issues.title: Turbo cannot parse pnpm 11 lockfiles with new flat-string `patchedDependencies` format
source_issues.evidence: 每次 turbo run 发出警告 'Could not resolve workspaces. Unable to convert to yaml: patchedDependencies... invalid type: string, expected struct PatchFile'，所有 pnpm 11 用户在 CI 中均受影响，lockfile 感知缓存退化。

signals.topic: schema.json URL redirects to Okta requiring authentication, blocking schema downloads
signals.summary: https://v2-9-5.turborepo.dev/schema.json 重定向到 Okta 认证页面，导致用户无法下载 schema 文件进行验证，IDE 集成和自动化工具受阻。
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：schema.json 是 turbo.json 验证的核心资源。认证拦截直接导致用户无法获取 schema，IDE/编辑器集成和 CI 验证流程完全阻断。

source_issues.title: https://v2-9-5.turborepo.dev/schema.json redirects to Okta
source_issues.evidence: 用户访问 schema.json URL 被重定向到 Okta 认证页面，预期行为是不需要认证即可下载 schema 文件进行 turbo.json 验证。

signals.topic: turbo watch dev incorrectly triggers package dev tasks when dependent app changes
signals.summary: turbo watch dev 在应用内部文件变化时，错误地重新运行该应用所依赖的所有包的 dev 脚本，而正确行为是：应用 dev 服务器自行处理内部变更，无需重启包任务。
aliases: turbo watch triggers wrong dev tasks
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断（开发体验）：turbo watch 是现代 monorepo 开发的核心功能。错误的依赖触发逻辑导致 watch 模式下不必要的任务重建，直接降低开发效率，与 turbo watch 的设计意图相悖。

source_issues.title: `turbo watch dev` runs package `dev` when app depending on it changes
source_issues.evidence: 用户在 watch 模式下修改 app 内部文件（如 README），不相关的包 dev 任务被错误重新触发（有视频证据）。破坏 watch 模式的预期行为，浪费开发时间。

signals.topic: vercel env add --sensitive --yes --value 静默保存空字符串，导致生产环境静默故障
signals.summary: 使用 --sensitive --yes --value 组合时，CLI 返回成功（exit 0），但环境变量实际被保存为空字符串。生产函数因此 500，用户需数小时排查才发现变量值为空。
aliases: env add --sensitive saves empty value silently
silent environment variable corruption with --sensitive flag
signals.review_reason: 静默数据损坏：CLI 明确返回成功但实际保存空值，用户在生产环境经历数小时 500 错误才定位原因。vercel env ls 显示 Encrypted 标签（看起来正常），但 vercel env pull 实际为空字符串。--sensitive + --yes + --value 的组合在保存前静默丢弃值，无任何错误提示。这不是功能请求，而是现有功能的静默损坏，直接阻断生产部署。

source_issues.title: vercel env add --value V --sensitive --yes silently saves empty string
source_issues.evidence: CLI returns exit code 0 with success message, but vercel env pull shows empty string. Reproduced in both shell-quoted and Python subprocess invocations. Hours of production 500 errors diagnosed before root cause found.

signals.topic: vercel env add preview --yes 提示使用该命令后仍报 git_branch_required，CLI 自身建议的命令无法在非交互模式下工作
signals.summary: CLI 在交互式失败响应中建议的 next[] 命令 vercel env add NAME preview --value <value> --yes 实际仍报 git_branch_required，形成用户无法绕过的提示循环，无法实现自动化/CI 场景下的无提示添加。
aliases: env add preview non-interactive fails with self-suggested command
CLI hint command for preview branch env add does not work
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：非交互/CI 场景下无法通过 CLI 添加 preview 分支环境变量。用户只能转向 REST API 绕行。更关键的是，CLI 自己给出的错误提示中 next[] 数组包含的就是失败命令本身——这是自我矛盾的 UX 陷阱，自动化和 CI 流程完全无法使用该功能。

source_issues.title: vercel env add NAME preview --value <V> --yes returns git_branch_required despite hint suggesting that exact form
source_issues.evidence: CLI itself suggests the exact command that then fails. next[1] is identical to the rejected command. --force flag does not help. Interactive add works; non-interactive path for 'all preview branches' is completely broken. Only workaround is direct REST API call.

signals.topic: VercelResponse TypeScript 类型声明 Express 辅助方法（res.status/res.json）但 Rust Node 运行时不存在，导致生产环境 TypeError 500
signals.summary: @vercel/node 的 VercelResponse 类型声明了 res.status()、res.json()、res.send() 等 Express 风格辅助方法，但新的 Rust Node 运行时实际只提供原生 http.ServerResponse。tsc --noEmit 编译通过，生产部署后立即抛出 TypeError: res.status is not a function，返回 HTTP 500。
aliases: VercelResponse TypeScript types mismatch Rust Node runtime
res.status is not a function in Rust Node runtime despite type declarations
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断+关键功能不可用：TypeScript 编译通过（tsc --noEmit 无错误），但生产环境第一次调用即抛出 TypeError 导致 HTTP 500。runtime 和类型定义之间存在根本性不匹配，用户只有在 vercel --prod 部署后才能发现。严重影响从旧版 Vercel 文档迁移的用户群体。

source_issues.title: @vercel/node TypeScript types declare Express-style helpers (res.status, res.json) that are absent in the Rust Node runtime
source_issues.evidence: Production deployment returns HTTP 500 with x-vercel-error: FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED. Stack trace shows TypeError: res.status is not a function at handler. tsc --noEmit passes locally, making the mismatch only discoverable after vercel --prod deploy. Affects any project following older Vercel Express-style examples.

signals.topic: Node.js 运行时在每次冷启动时输出 DEP0169 url.parse() 废弃警告至 production 日志（level:error），干扰日志监控和告警系统
signals.summary: @vercel/node 内部使用 url.parse() 每次冷启动都会触发 Node.js DEP0169 废弃警告，以 level:error 写入 Vercel production 日志。grep 和告警系统被污染，无法从用户代码层面消除警告（只能设 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation 全局关闭）。
aliases: Node.js runtime DEP0169 deprecation warning on every cold start pollutes production logs
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降：每次冷启动产生 level:error 日志条目，污染生产日志搜索和基于错误级别的告警/分页系统。url.parse() 位于 @vercel/node 运行时自身代码中，用户代码无法绕过，只能全局关闭所有废弃警告（代价过大）。虽然不直接阻断主流程，但干扰关键的可观测性基础设施。

source_issues.title: Production Node.js runtime emits DEP0169 url.parse() deprecation warning on every cold start
source_issues.evidence: DEP0169 warning appears in production logs at level:error for every cold-started request, regardless of user code. grep of user bundle confirms no direct url.parse() usage in user code. Cannot be silenced from user code; only mitigation suppresses all deprecation warnings. Pollutes log searches and paging/alerting systems filtering by error level.

signals.topic: Python 构建优先使用 uv.lock 导致 dev 依赖被包含在部署包中，可能触发 250MB 函数大小限制
signals.summary: Vercel Python 构建优先使用 uv.lock，当项目同时有 requirements.txt 和 uv.lock 时，uv.lock 会被优先使用，导致 dev 依赖也被打包进 250MB 限制的 serverless 函数中，增加超出限制的风险。
aliases: Python build prefers uv.lock over requirements.txt includes dev dependencies
uv.lock includes dev dependencies causing Python function size limit risk
signals.review_reason: 潜在成本损失风险：uv.lock 优先策略在有 dev 依赖时可能导致超出 250MB 限制。当前仅为 feature preference，issue 中无用户实际触发超限的具体失败案例，3 条评论均为功能讨论而非问题报告。置信度偏低，归为 P2。

source_issues.title: Prefer requirements.txt over uv.lock for Python function builds to avoid excess dev dependencies
source_issues.evidence: Issue describes risk of deploying unnecessary dev packages due to uv.lock being preferred. References 250MB size limit. Discussion mentions uv supports dependency groups for dev deps. Proposal is a feature preference/behavior change request, not a confirmed bug causing actual failures.

signals.topic: Zed consumes 17GB+ RAM and hangs during project indexing on macOS after running for days
signals.summary: Memory leak accumulates over days of use, causing 17GB+ RAM consumption and 87% CPU usage during project indexing, forcing users to force-kill and restart Zed
signals.review_reason: 17GB+ memory consumption and perpetual hang detection cycle constitutes severe resource exhaustion that blocks the user's workflow and forces force-kill restart. While count=1, the severity (memory exhaustion + hang detection loop) and user impact (complete workflow interruption after days of work) clearly qualify as a high-impact user pain point.

source_issues.title: Memory leak (17GB+) and perpetual hang detected cycle during project indexing on MacOS Sequoia
source_issues.evidence: Zed consumes 17GB+ RAM and 87% CPU after opening a project following days of use. Requires force-kill to recover.

signals.topic: Zed crashes or becomes unresponsive when opening very large files
signals.summary: Opening extremely large files causes Zed to crash and become unresponsive, requiring force-kill, with no safeguard or contingency for file size limits
signals.review_reason: Crash on large file is a clear primary-flow failure. Zed fails to open files that other editors handle, with no graceful degradation or user warning. This blocks a legitimate use case and is a definite user pain point.

source_issues.title: Zed crashes on opening a very large file
source_issues.evidence: Opening a C++ generated file causes memory usage to spike rapidly and Zed becomes unresponsive, requiring force kill. User provides video proof.

signals.topic: gopls becomes unresponsive in large Go projects, breaking autocomplete and error reporting
signals.summary: In very large Go files, gopls stops responding causing autocomplete (Ctrl+Space) to do nothing and errors to not update, requiring file close/reopen as workaround
signals.review_reason: Autocomplete and error reporting are core development workflows. Their failure in large Go projects is a significant developer experience degradation, forcing manual workarounds. The evidence shows Zed-specific behavior (gopls logs fine, Zed stops responding), confirming this is a Zed-side issue.

source_issues.title: Irresponsive gopls in large project
source_issues.evidence: Ctrl+Space for autocomplete does nothing and errors are not updating. gopls logs show activity, suggesting Zed is the culprit. User must close and reopen file as workaround. Occurs on Windows 10 RTX 5060 Ti.

signals.topic: Endless git processes spawn on Zed startup and cannot be disabled
signals.summary: Zed spawns infinite git processes on startup even with git integration disabled in settings, causing resource waste and window handle errors
signals.review_reason: Endless spawn of git processes causes measurable resource waste and app instability. The fact that this persists even when git integration is disabled makes it a clear bug with direct user impact on startup performance and system resources.

source_issues.title: Endless git processes
source_issues.evidence: Zed endlessly starts and ends git processes on startup. Git integration is disabled in settings but issue persists. Logs show context server timeouts and window handle errors.

signals.topic: Java Language Server (jdtls) keeps running after closing Zed or switching projects
signals.summary: jdtls process remains alive after Zed is closed or when switching to another language project, wasting system resources
signals.review_reason: LSP server not being cleaned up on Zed exit is a resource leak causing memory/CPU waste and potential port conflicts. This is a clear lifecycle management bug that users can observe in their system process list.

source_issues.title: Java Language server still running after closing the zed process or opening another language project
source_issues.evidence: jdtls process remains running after Zed is closed or when opening another language project. Screenshots confirm process persists. Also shows 'resolve completion' internal errors in LSP logs.
